correctness.rationale: For k near n, hazard (n/k)^alpha=1+u/(log n)+O((log n)^(-2)); using b_n=log n-log log n-log alpha gives local expected density (alpha log n/n) exp(-u-z). Product Laplace functionals and vanishing maximal summand prove the PPP. The convex bound (n/k)^alpha>=1+alpha(1-k/n) controls labels with u>R uniformly, ensuring global top points; the factorized Poisson intensity gives independent Exp spatial marks and Gumbel maxima. Independent Poisson type processes identify exact last labels, and conditional Poisson arrival variance ≤(1+log n)/(n^alpha H_n)<= (1+log n)/n transfers completion time. Independent finite tail-mass and mark approximations support but do not prove convergence.

After Poissonization/depoissonization the same joint law holds for Zipf coupon completion time and last coupon index, with iid endpoint marks of the last fixed number of types.
